source_name: Payten (PAYTEN DOOEL Skopje) — LinkedIn presence / corporate site
why_relevant: Regional payments/POS integrator with a Skopje legal entity; local hires and country-manager changes are announced on LinkedIn rather than in MK press. Direct competitor-adjacent to Printec.

source_name: bankarstvo.mk — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: MK banking trade outlet that republishes bank vacancy notices and appointment stories and pushes them to LinkedIn — a low-friction aggregator that surfaces items you would otherwise have to poll each bank page for.

source_name: DEKRA Arbeit Macedonia — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Named in the run scope; self-described market leader in MK temporary employment and recruitment. Its LinkedIn feed carries client vacancies (often anonymised 'a leading financial institution') and occasional placement congratulations — an early indicator of hiring by banks that have not yet posted publicly.

source_name: Vrabotuvanje.com (vrabotuvanje.com.mk) — LinkedIn page + job board
why_relevant: Dominant MK job board that also sells headhunting and selection services; bank vacancy volume and seniority mix here is a quantifiable proxy for org growth/restructuring, and its own posts sometimes name placements.

source_name: Executive Search Consulting (ESC) Macedonia — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Local HR-consultancy positioned as an executive search house; senior finance mandates in MK frequently run through a small number of such firms, and their LinkedIn feed is where a search is advertised before the appointee is public.

source_name: HeadHunting.mk — MK headhunting agency (IT / Marketing / Finance)
why_relevant: Explicitly specialises in Finance-team placements in MK; open mandates on the site indicate which institutions are rebuilding a function before any announcement.

source_name: InHunt World — North Macedonia headhunting partner page
why_relevant: Global executive-search network page that names its MK member firm — a pointer for discovering the local headhunters that international banking groups use when hiring into Skopje.

source_name: Stanton Chase Belgrade — regional executive search office covering North Macedonia
why_relevant: Explicitly lists North Macedonia in its coverage and does CEO/CFO/CRO/board mandates; large MK bank C-suite searches for foreign-owned banks are more likely to be run out of Belgrade than Skopje. Its LinkedIn feed and insights posts flag regional banking mandates.

source_name: Motivi — MK HR / recruitment consultancy
why_relevant: Local HR consultancy appearing alongside DEKRA and headhunting.mk in MK recruitment searches; another channel through which bank vacancies are intermediated and occasionally announced.

source_name: zk.mk directory — Employment agencies (recruitment & staffing) in Skopje
why_relevant: Local business directory category that enumerates the full population of Skopje staffing/recruitment agencies — the cheapest way to complete the recruiter actor map for this cell rather than discovering firms one search at a time.

source_name: Development Bank of North Macedonia (Развојна банка) — Management structure page
why_relevant: State development bank whose management page carries dated appointment language (acting CEO from a specific date, then confirmed) — an unusually precise public record of leadership transitions, and a validation anchor for LinkedIn claims.

source_name: nezavisen.mk — MK general news, banking appointment coverage
why_relevant: Mainstream MK outlet that carries CEO-level appointment stories with career-history detail (e.g. the Halkbank AD Skopje CEO change, including prior deputy-CEO roles and dates) — corroborates and dates what LinkedIn shows self-reported.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — member directory (payments/banking members)
why_relevant: Chamber member profiles carry current company contacts and representative names; useful for building and refreshing the actor map behind LinkedIn identities, and events pages reveal who currently represents each institution.

source_name: Datanyze / ZoomInfo / AroundDeal / Lusha — third-party employee-and-headcount aggregators for MK banks and CaSys
why_relevant: These B2B data vendors resell LinkedIn-derived management lists and headcount estimates for MK institutions (Silk Road Bank, NLB Banka, CaSys). Relevant as a documented ALTERNATIVE access path when LinkedIn itself is gated — but they are scraped derivatives with stale records and personal data, so treat as low-credibility and legally sensitive.

source_name: Kapital.mk (Kapital Media Group)
why_relevant: Flagship MK business media house (Kapital magazine since 1999, Дневен Капитал, special editions incl. 'Банките и бизнисот', 'Top 200', 'Претприемач и менаџер'). Runs long-form interviews with newly appointed bank CEOs and board members and covers restructuring/headcount stories that firms disclose quietly. Also runs Kapital Academy conferences whose speaker lists are a de-facto who's-who roster of current bank executives.

source_name: Sloboden Pecat — Economy desk (Слободен печат / Економија)
why_relevant: Major MK daily (founded 2013) with a standing economy section and an active interview franchise. Useful for the 'why did the CEO leave' context layer and for restructuring/redundancy reporting that trade press treats neutrally; broader political-economy framing than Bankarstvo.

source_name: Ekonomija i Biznis (Економија и бизнис) monthly magazine
why_relevant: Long-running MK monthly business magazine (editor-in-chief Biljana Radevska Grujovska since 2016) that runs executive interviews and sector analyses. Magazine format means fewer but deeper items — good for capturing org-structure descriptions and strategy rationales that news wires omit. URL is the conventional domain and should be treated as unverified until the deterministic liveness pass runs.

source_name: Fokus (Фокус)
why_relevant: Investigative-leaning MK weekly/portal named in the cell. Value here is the 'reveals-indirectly' category: political-appointment and patronage angles behind state-linked financial institutions (Development Bank, deposit insurance, state funds) that neutral trade press will not frame. Domain unconfirmed in this pass.

source_name: Portalb.mk (Albanian-language MK news, Meta.mk Foundation)
why_relevant: The principal Albanian-language MK news portal and the cell's designated bridge to the ~25% of the market mk-only searching misses. Confirmed to run appointment journalism in Albanian ('drejtori i ri', 'u zgjodh drejtor', 'Qeveria emëroi ... drejtor') across public institutions and enterprises; the same template applies to financial-sector appointments. Note a separate legacy archive at arkiv.portalb.mk holding older appointment stories.

source_name: Alsat (Alsat-M television, Albanian/Macedonian bilingual)
why_relevant: Bilingual MK broadcaster with an economy desk; runs studio interviews with executives, which is a distinct evidence type (video/transcript) from print appointment notices. Covers the Albanian-language market segment and its business community.

source_name: Telegrafi — Maqedoni / Ekonomi sections
source_subtype: regional news portal with MK vertical + source tag pages
why_relevant: Kosovo-based but the largest Albanian-language news operation, with dedicated North Macedonia and Economy verticals and tag pages that republish/aggregate Gazeta KOHA-Maqedoni and Alsat-M items. Useful as a secondary net for Albanian-language MK business news and as a pointer to MK Albanian outlets (its tag pages enumerate them).

source_name: Gazeta KOHA (Maqedoni)
why_relevant: Albanian-language daily published in North Macedonia; identified indirectly through Telegrafi's dedicated 'Gazeta KOHA-Maqedoni' tag, which confirms it as an active MK Albanian-language news producer. Complements Portalb for the Albanian-language business/appointment layer. Own-domain URL not confirmed in this pass.

source_name: Aktuale.mk (Albanian-language MK portal)
why_relevant: Albanian-language MK news portal surfaced while searching for appointment/resignation language; observed a story explicitly on a resignation and the naming of an acting director ('dha dorëheqjen', 'drejtori i komanduar'). Confirms the outlet uses precise personnel vocabulary that A5 extraction can key on. Sector focus is broad, not banking-specific.

source_name: Nova Makedonija (Нова Македонија) — business columns
why_relevant: Oldest MK daily; its opinion/column section carries banker- and banking-sector commentary (observed a column on 'the PM, the banks and business'). Weak on hard appointment facts but strong as the commentary layer that explains sector-wide pressure driving restructuring and executive turnover.

source_name: PlusInfo.mk
source_subtype: general news portal with republished business content
why_relevant: General MK news portal that syndicates/republishes business columns and economy items (observed carrying the same banking column as Nova Makedonija). Chiefly useful as a redundancy net: content that disappears behind a paywall or a site migration elsewhere often survives here.

source_name: Kapital Media Group LinkedIn / AmCham member profile
why_relevant: Publisher-side metadata: enumerates Kapital's product portfolio ('Банките и бизнисот', 'Претприемач и менаџер', Top 200, Top 100 exporters, Kapital Academy) and thereby tells the collector WHICH Kapital products to target for banking personnel content — a pointer to publication structure rather than to facts. AmCham membership page corroborates the group's identity.
